en.title: Inspect a desk sign
en.statement: The complete example prints Desk open. Read each labeled step, distinguish the message from its delimiters, then run the supplied program unchanged. Explain which characters become the message before continuing.
hints: Compare the requested message with the quoted text in the program.
Read the message characters separately from the punctuation that encloses them.
Preserve the required capitalization, spaces and statement order, then check again.
